sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports for empty state
sections.what: Brings in the icon type and the button component.
sections.why: The empty state needs an icon and a button.

sections.name: EmptyStateProps
sections.title: Shape of the empty state settings
sections.what: Defines what the empty state accepts: an icon, a title, a description, and an optional action with a label and a click handler.
sections.why: Lets any page show a consistent message when a list has no data.
sections.watch_out: The action is optional. If a page passes an action with no working handler, the button will appear but do nothing.

sections.name: EmptyState
sections.title: Empty state panel
sections.what: Draws a dashed, centered panel with an icon, a title, a short description, and an optional button when an action is supplied.
sections.why: Explains why a section is empty and offers a next step, instead of showing a blank space.

summary: A dashed box shown when a section has no data, with an icon, a title, a message and an optional button.
purpose: Tells the patient clearly that nothing is here yet and what they can do next.
why: Header says consistent pattern for missing data. Likely reason: the same look on every page.
how: Takes an icon, a title, a description and an optional action. Shows the icon in a square, then the title and description, then the button only if an action is passed.
inputs: An icon component, a title, a description, and an optional action with a label and click handler.
outputs: A visual block. Calls the action handler when the button is clicked.
risks: The button only appears when an action is passed, so the caller must pass one when the user needs a next step.
debug: If the button is missing, check that the action prop is passed. If the layout looks off, check the width and spacing of the parent.
